title: The Sacrifice Accepted in Mercy
intro: Close your eyes and picture a vast, silent valley where faith is tested to its limit. You are about to meet a figure whose calm submission in the face of an unimaginable command turned a moment of trial into an eternal symbol of obedience and divine mercy.
clues: I am remembered in the Quran among those who endured with steadfast patience.
I was at the center of a vision that tested submission to the command of Allah.
When told of the vision, I said to do as commanded and you will find me among the patient.
I was laid down for the sacrifice, but Allah called out that the vision was fulfilled.
Allah ransomed me with a great sacrifice, leaving honor for me among later generations.
I am Ismail, who with Ibrahim raised the foundations of the Sacred House, mentioned alongside Idris and Dhul-Kifl among the righteous.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Shu'ayb
Prophet Ismail (Ishmael)
Prophet Dhul-Kifl
Prophet Al-Yasa (Elisha)
Prophet Hud

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Being thrown into a blazing fire
Calling the dead back to life by Allah's permission
Denying the measure and balance in trade
The commanded sacrifice and willing submission
Being swallowed by a great fish
trial.answer: The commanded sacrifice and willing submission

location.label: Key Element
options: A baking oven gushing with water
A staff that became a serpent
A golden calf worshipped in absence
A wooden Ark in the flood
A great ram sent as ransom
location.answer: A great ram sent as ransom

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Struck by a mighty blast for rejecting the she-camel
Turned into an ape for transgression
Praised among the patient and righteous prophets
Swallowed by the earth for arrogance
Drowned in the sea while pursuing believers
outcome.answer: Praised among the patient and righteous prophets

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
